title: TemplateVersionWithdrawn.v1
description: Hook emitted by the existing Templates Service when a published version is withdrawn. WITHDRAWN is permanent (PRD INV-02).
$comment: Source: DISENO 4.3 catalog EV-02; RF-004; US-01.3.1. Producer: templates-service. Consumers: ms-template-catalog. Channel: templates-service outbox -> global EventBridge bus -> rule -> SQS FIFO global-ms-template-catalog-templates-service.fifo. Ordering/partition key: templateId (FIFO MessageGroupId). Idempotency key: eventId. Guarantee: at-least-once, ordered per template (FIFO). Versioning: contract with the platform team (owner of the Templates Service); additive within v1. dataClass: TEMPLATE_PUBLIC (DISENO 4.3). Template metadata only; stays in the home region (not replicated to cells).
x-channel: templates-service outbox -> global EventBridge bus -> rule -> SQS FIFO global-ms-template-catalog-templates-service.fifo

reasonCode.description: Withdrawal reason code defined by the Templates Service in the hook contract (ADR-015); a code, never free text.
